item.title: Woodland Park Zoo gets giant tortoises from soon-to-close Reptile Zoo
item.description: Isaac Petersen named his two female Aldabra giant tortoises Cera and Ali after two dinosaurs in The Land Before Time" animated franchise.

item.title: Families of plane crash victims ask U.S. appeals court to revive a criminal case against Boeing
item.description: Thirty-one families that lost relatives in two fatal crashes of Boeing 737 Max jetliners asked a federal appeals court on Thursday to revive a criminal case against the aircraft manufacturer.

item.title: Jon Talton, Seattle Times business columnist and author, dies at 69
item.description: In the final pages of his 2010 novel “Deadline Man,” the writer Jon Talton’s main character — a business columnist at a Seattle daily newspaper — sits on a bench at 2 a.m. as the newspaper presses roll. He can feel the vibration on the sidewalk, as the immense machines “perform their nightly miracle” and stories wing their way onto waiting newsprint; it’s a moment of deep connection for him, illuminating why he does what he does.

item.title: Seahawks rookie safety Nick Emmanwori expects to play in Super Bowl after injuring ankle in practice
item.description: Seahawks rookie safety Nick Emmanwori expects to play in the Super Bowl despite injuring his ankle during Wednesday’s practice at San Jose State University as Seattle prepares to face New England.

item.title: A glimmer of hope for democracy in Venezuela as opponents test the limits of free speech
item.description: CARACAS, Venezuela (AP) — Andrés Velásquez didn’t stick around to become one more government critic jailed after Venezuela’s 2024 presidential election.

item.title: Brees, Fitzgerald headline Pro Football Hall of Fame class missing Belichick
item.description: Drew Brees and Larry Fitzgerald headlined the 2026 Pro Football Hall of Fame class featuring five players but not six-time Super Bowl winning head coach Bill Belichick.

item.title: Matthew Stafford edges Drake Maye for AP NFL Most Valuable Player award
item.description: Matthew Stafford edged Drake Maye for the AP NFL Most Valuable Player award on Thursday night in the closest race since Peyton Manning and Steve McNair were co-winners in 2003.

item.title: Bobby Wagner named Walter Payton NFL Man of the Year
item.description: Charitable work honoring the legacy of his mother through financial assistance for stroke research and rehabilitation with the Phenia Mae Fund earned Washington Commanders linebacker Bobby Wagner the Walter Payton NFL Man of the Year award for 2025.

item.title: Prep Basketball Roundup: King’s Way Christian boys hold off Seton Catholic to remain in second place in Trico League
item.description: Patrick Carney scored 11 of his 17 points in a key fourth quarter as the King’s Way Christian boys basketball team positioned itself to claim the No. 2 seed to district with a 56-52 win over rival Seton Catholic on Thursday.
